title: Integrate Google AdSense script

requirements.text: Add Google AdSense script tag to the HTML head section with async loading, source URL 'https://pagead2.googlesyndication.com/pagead/js/adsbygoogle.js?client=ca-pub-4905807488237044', and crossorigin attribute set to 'anonymous'

quotes:
PLACE THE CODE OF GOOGLE ADSENSE <script async src="https://pagead2.googlesyndication.com/pagead/js/adsbygoogle.js?client=ca-pub-4905807488237044"
     crossorigin="anonymous"></script>

acceptanceCriteria: The AdSense script is present in frontend/index.html within the <head> section
The script includes the async attribute
The script src URL matches exactly: https://pagead2.googlesyndication.com/pagead/js/adsbygoogle.js?client=ca-pub-4905807488237044
The crossorigin attribute is set to 'anonymous'
The script loads without errors in browser console

constraints: Do not modify any backend files
Use the exact AdSense client ID provided: ca-pub-4905807488237044
nonGoals: Creating ad placement units or display logic
Adding ad blocks to specific pages
